My `build_random_tree` computes `order.index(c)` for children indices — but `order.index()` returns the FIRST occurrence of an equal node! Since nodes are dicts, `index` uses `==` comparison which compares dict contents — two different nodes with equal content compare equal! So `order.index(c)` can return the wrong index.
